programme.title: Muscle Beach Party
programme.desc: Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello and the gang are back together in the 2nd of American International's Beach Party films and this time the beach is overrun by muscle men and their obnoxious trainer.

programme.title: Bikini Beach
programme.desc: There are big waves crashing at Bikini Beach! The beach is close to becoming a retirement village. And a British pop star comes between Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon). Will it all be resolved by the end of summer vacation?

programme.title: Beach Blanket Bingo
programme.desc: When a publicity stunt to promote the singing career of Sugar Kane (Linda Evans) balloons out of control, Frankie (Frankie Avalon), Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and the gang are pulled into the ensuing comic adventures.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Shaft (2000)
programme.desc: Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: An Eye For An Eye (1981)
programme.desc: A SFPD undercover narcotics cop aims to avenge his partner's death and destroy a drug-smuggling ring operated by the Chinese Triads.

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade
programme.desc: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Adventureland
programme.desc: From the director of SUPERBAD comes a coming-of-age comedy of big dreams, hysterical consequences, and young love, set in a run-down amusement park.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Soapdish
programme.desc: Sally Field leads an all-star cast in this side-splittingly funny look at a scandal-ridden TV soap opera.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Outlaw Justice
programme.desc: Starring Kris Kristofferson and Willie Nelson. Two aging gunfighters re-form their old gang to avenge the murder of one of the former members.

programme.title: The Claim (2017)
programme.desc: THE CLAIM is an epic story of love, passion and redemption set against the winter landscape of the Sierra Nevada Mountains and the making of California. Dillon is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed film chronicles the true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered a decades-long cover-up of child abuse within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: The story of Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez), a single mother born in the boroughs of New York City, who works as a maid in a first-class Manhattan hotel. By a twist of fate and mistaken identity, Marisa meets Christopher Marshall (Ralph Fiennes)

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Seven complete strangers of widely varying personality characteristics are involuntarily placed in an endless maze containing deadly traps.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: The Amityville Horror (2005)
programme.desc: Based on the original movie, this modern remake tells the true story about a large house on the coast of Long Island where a newlywed couple and their three children move into, unaware that a murder took place in the house several years back.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: A remake of George Mihalka's 1981 classic slasher film, MY BLOODY VALENTINE takes place ten years after a devastating coal mining accident when a string of gruesome murders plagues a town.

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

programme.title: American Gigolo (1980)
programme.desc: Julian Kay has it all: the Mercedes, the clothes, access to Beverly Hills' swankiest establishments, and a stable of rich, female clients. But it all falls apart after he does a favor for his former pimp and the trick turns up dead a short while later.

programme.title: Manhunter (1986)
programme.desc: Using his uncanny ability to get inside psychopaths' minds, former FBI agent, Will Graham, returns to action to hunt down a serial killer.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: The Eternal Daughter
programme.desc: At an eerie hotel haunted by its mysterious past, an artist and her elderly mother (both played by Tilda Swinton) confront long-buried secrets.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: The Harder They Come
programme.desc: Reggae legend Jimmy Cliff stars as Ivan Martin, an aspiring singer hoping to make a name for himself. Robbed of his money and possessions, he finds work with a self-righteous preacher

programme.title: Real Life
programme.desc: In his directorial debut. Brooks presents a hilarious account of what happens to a typical American family when a group of filmmakers moves in with them to record "real life."

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: In the very near future, cattle, fish, and even the family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal - that is, until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: XXX

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Big Fish

programme.title: Ella Enchanted

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter

programme.title: Source Code

programme.title: Save The Last Dance

programme.title: Vantage Point

programme.title: The Net

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Fun in Acapulco

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis takes to the skies over the island paradise of Kauai. He’s a partner in a helicopter charter service. Romance, naturally, is in the air for the King…but his business may be grounded.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A tight-knit team of skilled combat vets turned mercenaries, set out to save the innocent and punish the guilty in this blistering action-packed thriller.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Barney and his mercenaries race to stop five tons of weapons-grade plutonium from falling into the wrong hands in this all-star, action-packed sequel.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Missing in Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura Pet Detective is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eye to eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Dennis Miller and Jeremy Northam star in this hit thriller about a computer expert whose life is "erased" by a computer conspiracy. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: A Few Good Men
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as a brash Navy lawyer who's teamed with a gung-ho litigator (Demi Moore) in a politically explosive murder case, defending two Marines accused of killing a fellow soldier

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Amnesiac gunman Jericho is rescued and befriended by a charismatic and itinerant cowboy/preacher named Joshua. Together they survive certain danger, while Jericho searches to find the answer to his lost identity.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee

programme.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
programme.desc: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

programme.title: Mid-Century

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Flight 7500
programme.desc: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: When 14-year-old Susie Salmon was murdered, she left unfinished life behind. But now from her place in a strange but beautiful in-between world, she must help her father catch her killer.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his partner's brutal murder.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: When a group of cannibal savages kidnaps settlers from the small town of Bright Hope, an unlikely team of gunslingers, led by Sheriff Hunt (Kurt Russell), sets out to bring them home.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: A rugged American adventure-travel journalist on assignment in the Australian outback encounters a man-eating crocodile.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: In this black-Comedy spin-off of Alfred Hitchcock's STRANGERS ON A TRAIN, a writing student tries to persuade his instructor to trade murders.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Lots of laughs and a great camaraderie is the recipe for two street-wise cops that have decided to quit the force and open a bar.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: A bodybuilder headed through town to Vegas is thrust into the dangerous plot of a violent crime family when she falls into a steamy romance with her trainer (Kristen Stewart) in this heart-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Under the Skin
programme.desc: A voluptuous woman of unknown origin (Scarlett Johansson) combs the highways in search of isolated men, luring a series of lost souls into an otherworldly lair. From visionary director Jonathan Glazer comes a masterpiece of science fiction.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: Lamb
programme.desc: In rural Iceland, a childless couple discovers a strange and unnatural newborn in their sheep barn. They raise her as their own, but sinister forces are determined to return the creature to the wilderness that birthed her.

programme.title: The Peacemaker
programme.desc: When a train carrying atomic warheads crashes in the Soviet Union, nuclear specialist Dr. Kelly discovers the accident is really part of a plot to cover up the theft of the weapons.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: When an international team of former Cold War intelligence adversaries meet in a Warehouse, their venture of friendship, intrigue and betrayal has just begun.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Death Wish
programme.desc: In this explosive story of revenge and urban violence, Charles Bronson plays Paul Kersey, a bleeding-heart liberal who has a change of opinion after his wife and daughter are violently attacked by a gang of thugs in their apartment.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threaten to kill the hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Ben Foster) discover a terrifying reality after awaking disoriented, aboard a seemingly abandoned spaceship.

programme.title: The Girl With All the Gifts
programme.desc: In the future, a strange fungus has changed nearly everyone into a thoughtless, flesh-eating monster. When a scientist and a teacher find a girl who seems to be immune to the fungus, they all begin a journey to save humanity.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman (Shailene Woodley) learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as an idealistic young wheeler-dealer whose life is changed forever when he discovers he has an autistic savant older brother (Dustin Hoffman, in a Best Actor Oscar-winning performance).

programme.title: The Net

programme.title: Premonition

programme.title: Uncle P

programme.desc: When a Martian scout named Go-Go is sent to explore Earth for a possible conquest, he lands in the middle of a wild, teenage pajama party, giving Mars second thoughts about invasion...and turning the party into an out-of-this-world cosmic shindig!

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: Rival groups--one rich and serious, the other party animals--do battle in this comedy set at a mountain resort's ski school.

programme.title: Killer Elite
programme.desc: A special-ops agent must rescue his mentor.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A tight-knit team of skilled combat vets turned mercenaries, set out to save the innocent and punish the guilty in this blistering action-packed thriller.

programme.title: Mid-Century
programme.desc: Academy Award Nominee Bruce Dern and Stephen Lang star in this horror tale about a couple renting a vacation home who meet the spirits of the architect and his two wives—plus their deranged, living son.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A couple’s search for a dream home plunges them into a terrifying nightmare after they are trapped in a mysterious, labyrinth-like neighborhood of identical houses.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: When 14-year-old Susie Salmon was murdered, she left unfinished life behind. But now from her place in a strange but beautiful in-between world, she must help her father catch her killer.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Bad Ass
programme.desc: A Vietnam veteran who becomes a local hero after saving a man from attackers on a city bus decides to take action when his best friend is murdered and the police show little interest in solving the crime.

programme.desc: A Shippo se le envía una carta desafiándolo a una batalla. El remitente de la carta es Soten Raijyu, y aún es solo un niño. Investigó a Inuyasha y los demás y determinó que eran demasiado fuertes, por lo que centra su atención en Shippo.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Un demonio nacido de un pedazo de carne que Naraku descartó se transforma en un hombre sin rostro y se roba el bello rostro de Muso, un monje viajero. El demonio se llama a sí mismo Muso y mata y saquea a lo largo de su camino a la aldea de Kaede.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso ataca a Kagome. Inuyasha lo destruye con su Cicatriz de Viento. Naraku, que estaba viendo el evento, le dice a Kagura que le diga a Inuyasha a dónde fue Muso. Después de que Inuyasha y los otros se van, Muso se regenera.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Muso se regenera incluso cuando fue golpeado con la Cicatriz del Viento. Miroku le dice a Inuyasha que Muso tiene un corazón en el área donde tiene una marca de araña. Pero Kagura interfiere, y las avispas del infierno quitan el fragmento de Muso.

programme.title: Inuyasha The Movie: Affections touching across time
programme.desc: El padre de Inuyasha derrotó a una poderosa polilla yōkai china llamada Hyōga, hace quinientos años. El fragmento de Joya Shikon revive a su hijo, Menōmaru, y a sus fieles sirvientes, Ruri y Hari (que planean vengar a su familia).

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y sus amigos encuentran un huevo. No saben de dónde viene, ni qué tipo de animal es. Maya decide encontrar su nido antes de que eclosione

programme.title: Naruto: ¡La Batalla Genin! Los Nueve Novatos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se inscriben al Examen Chunin, en el tres ninjas deben formar equipo y ninguno puede fallar. El trabajo en equipo es indispensable. Se quedan estupefactos al ver que hay muchos otros que persiguen el mismo sueño.

programme.title: Naruto: Enciendan Motores: Los Examenes Chunin Comienzan
programme.desc: Naruto y su equipo comienzan la prueba, un examen escrito. El examinador es un jonin llamado Ibiki. Aprobar el examen depende de los tres. Sasuke y Sakura están preocupados de que si Naruto responde mal, también fallarán.

programme.title: Naruto: La Décima Pregunta: Todo O Nada
programme.desc: La parte más difícil es la pregunta número 10. Antes de que escuchen la pregunta, Ibiki explica una regla muy severa: si responden mal a la pregunta, reprobarán el primer examen y el equipo perderá el derecho de tomar otros Exámenes en el futuro.

programme.title: Naruto: Reporte Especial: ¡En Vivo Desde El Bosque De La Muerte!
programme.desc: Konohamaru, el nieto del Tercer Hokage de la Aldea de la Hoja, aparece en el Examen, junto con Moegi y Udon, para cubrir los eventos en el periódico de la Academia Ninja. Konohamaru admira a Naruto y hace entrevistas a los personajes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Examen Chunin Segunda Etapa: El Bosque De La Muerte
programme.desc: Llegan al bosque de la Muerte, a la segunda parte del Examen. Cada equipo recibirá un pergamino. El equipo debe robar a otro equipo y después llegar a la torre con ambos pergaminos. La encargada del examen, Anko les da un consejo: “¡No se dejen matar!”

programme.title: Naruto: Comer O Ser Comido: Pánico En El Bosque
programme.desc: El segundo examen comienza. Sasuke se da cuenta de que un enemigo ha tomado la apariencia de Naruto y lo sigue. Sasuke rescata a Naruto, que estaba atado. Los tres compañeros de equipo deciden crear una contraseña por si vuelven a separarse de nuevo.

programme.title: Naruto: El contraataque de Naruto: Nunca Rendirse
programme.desc: El ninja que ataca a Sasuke y Sakura es muy poderoso. Sasuke casi entrega su pergamino, pero Naruto lo detiene de un golpe. La ira de Naruto crece al luchar, y su poder aflora. Entre tanto, la examinadora Anko descubre un problema sobre los participantes.

programme.title: Naruto: El Sharingan Revivido: Jutsu Flama De Dragón
programme.desc: Sasuke se da cuenta de que se equivocó al querer huir. Asumiendo el control de Naruto, Sasuke utiliza su Sharingan con toda su fuerza. El ninja se presenta como Orochimaru y desaparece, dejando una marca en el cuello de Sasuke.

programme.title: Naruto: La Promesa Del Cejudo: Amor Imperecedero Y Protección
programme.desc: Anko siente que Orochimaru se ha introducido en el examen y empieza a perseguirlo. Incluso con sus habilidades de jonin, es incapaz de detener al intruso. A pesar de estar agotada por la batalla, Sakura intenta detener al enemigo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Sakura Florece!
programme.desc: Protegiendo a Sakura, que no puede moverse, Lee se enfrenta a los tres ninjas del sonidoen solitario. Utiliza su ataque sorpresa, pero no tiene efecto. Después de recibir golpes de Dosu, Lee se desploma. Sakura se pone en pie para defenderlos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comiencen los finales de la Cuidad de Batallas! ¡Los ocho finalistas tendrán sus habilidades y resilencia puestas a prueba definitiva en una arena de duelos de miles de pies en el cielo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de las finales del torneo de la Cuidad de Batallas, ¡y Yugi se enfrenta contra el espíritu maligno del Anillo del Millenio que posee Bakura!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura activa al Tablero del Destino, ¡que garantiza que Yugi pierda en cinco turnos o menos! También, ¡el Santuario Oscuro de Baukra le quita puntos a Yugi en cada jugada!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está listo para desatar el golpe final y ganar el duelo, pero hay chance de que Bakura no sobreviva a la explosión. ¿Yugi atacará para avanzar en las finales del torneo, o perderá el duelo para salvar la vida de Bakura?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El origen de las cartas de los Dioses Egípcios es revelada al fin! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi en un viaje por el tiempo y vuelven al la creación del juego Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y todos los poderes peligrosos que fueron soltados!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En la segunda batalla de las finales de la Ciudad de Batallas, Odion confunde a Joey para paralizar el duelo. Puede ser que Joey tenga una estrategia perfecta para contraatacar a Odion, ¿o pueder ser que Joey caiga en otra trampa?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La carta de Odion llamada Encarnación de Apophis pisotea los monstruos de Joey… ¡y a sus puntos de vida! ¿Es Joey capaz de utilizar los monstruos que él ganó anteriormente en el torneo, o ya está demasiado agitado para montar un contraataque efectivo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenético festín cuando Serket de Odion devora los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en unas fases más poderosas de su evolución! ¿Como Joey le ganará a Serket cuando se come todos los monstruos de él al momento que los convoca?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Odion usa una carta de Dios Egipcio falsa para convocar El Dragón Alado de Ra para que acabe con el resto de los puntos de vida de Joey! ¿Pero puede ser que el El Dragón Alado de Ra va a castigar a todos los sin valor de convocarlo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Para pagar su deuda con el Gran Gino, Sid deberá trabajar para él. / Cuando Jamie O, el hermano de Gerald, se enamora de una chica, Gerald por fin tiene un hermano que lo trata bien.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Miriam reemplaza a Bob en su trabajo, pero comienza a distanciarse más de lo normal de Helga. / Oskar, quien nunca aprendió a leer, le pide a Arnold que le enseñe.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold, Gerald, Sid, Stinky y Harold dan un paseo por el parque de noche, teniendo una aventura digna de una leyenda urbana. / Es Viernes 13, y Wolfgang y Edmund se asegurarán que Arnold y Gerald tengan mucha mala suerte.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Big Bob compra un loro de mascota, pero cuando el loro comienza a repetir un poema de Helga para Arnold y se escapa, Helga debe recuperarlo. / Gerald vende tortugas de chocolate de las niñas exploradoras para poder comprar un gocart.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold tratará de gustarle en serio a Lila llevándola al festival anual del queso, pero Helga se encargará de que eso no pase. / Harold va a un crucero para bajar de peso, pero cuando vuelve mucho más gordo, Arnold le ofrece su ayuda.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Todos comienzan una corrida contra el tiempo para detener a Azula de su siniestra conquista de Ba Sing Se. El destino de Aang pende de un hilo, al igual que el de Zuko.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de sufrir lesiones graves al final de la segunda temporada, Aang despierta a bordo de un barco de la Nación del Fuego. Mientras tanto, Zuko viaja de regreso a casa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Para camuflarse mejor como verdaderos ciudadanos de la Nación del Fuego, los niños roban ropas tradicionales. Aang explora una escuela de la Nación del Fuego. Zuko visita a su tío en prisión.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando el grupo llega a un pueblo pescadero que se encuentra en sufirmiento, descubren que un misterioso espíritu está ayudando a los aldeanos.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Sokka siente que no está contribuyendo lo suficiente al grupo, busca a un misterioso maestro que le enseñe todo sobre las espadas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai y Ty Lee se van de vacaciones a la casa de playa de Lo y Li, donde aprenden mucho sobre sí mismos y los demás. Mientras tanto, Aang y su grupo se enfrentan a un nuevo enemigo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y Zuko tienen aventuras paralelas en donde conocen la historia de sus antepasados, pero ¿en qué les beneficia las historias de Roku y Sozin en este momento?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Toph descubre una forma rápida de ganar dinero, Katara expresa su desacuerdo y la brecha entre ellas tiene consecuencias desastrosas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños investigan misteriosas desapariciones en una ciudad fantasmagórica. Katara conoce a una Maestra Agua que le enseña una técnica de agua control prohibida.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En la víspera del eclipse, la ansiedad de Aang saca lo peor de él. Sus sueños se convierten en pesadillas y pronto ya no puede distinguir el sueño de la realidad.

programme.title: Rush: Beyond the Lighted Stage
programme.desc: Amigos, colegas y músicos comentan el legado y evolución de la banda de rock canadiense de los años setenta hasta su actual estilo de rock.

programme.title: Pet Shop Boys in Concert
programme.desc: Un concierto visualmente espectacular que combina éxitos del synth-pop con actuaciones de primer nivel.

programme.title: Prince and The Revolution: The Purple Rain Tour
programme.desc: La gira Purple Rain de 1985 de Prince and The Revolution, con canciones como "Let's Go Crazy", "Little Red Corvette", "When Doves Cry" y "Purple Rain".

programme.title: Encuentro Explosivo
programme.desc: Cuando June conoce a un misterioso extraño, cree que ha encontrado al hombre de sus sueños pero descubre que es un súper espía fugitivo que la involucra en una emocionante persecución.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Misión Secreta
programme.desc: Un senador estadounidense es asesinado en Washington por un espía ruso. Un agente de la CIA retirado se ve obligado a colaborar con un joven agente del FBI para atrapar al criminal.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Esta producción satírica presenta a un grupo de huérfanos que se embarca en diversas aventuras.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: Parodia de "300" y otras películas. El rey Leónidas y su ejército de 12 hombres luchan contra Jerjes de Persia para defender la libertad de Esparta.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Un estudiante de secundaria se enamora de su vecina, una hermosa actriz pornográfica.

programme.title: La Invocación 2
programme.desc: Pasaron muchos años después de los misteriosos y terribles hechos provocados por una cinta de vídeo maldita, que provocó la muerte de varias personas.

programme.title: Hospital del Terror
programme.desc: Una fría noche de diciembre, un equipo de investigaciones paranormales ponen la mira en un sangriento sanatorio de Hillcrest para contestar a una vieja pregunta: ¿Hay vida después de la muerte?

programme.title: Webcam Fantasma
programme.desc: Nate, en arresto domiciliario y acusado de abuso sexual, tiene una cita virtual con Mia, quien es asesinada en línea. Atrapado en casa, Nate debe averiguar si es real o solo un engaño.

programme.title: Atrapados
programme.desc: El desastre del submarino 2000 K-141 Kursk es seguido por negligencia gubernamental. Mientras los marineros luchan por sobrevivir, sus familias luchan desesperadamente contra obstáculos políticos y obstáculos imposibles para salvarlos.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Película independiente situada en la peligrosa frontera entre México y Estados Unidos. Tras cruzar la frontera de manera ilegal, Miguel, es acusado injustamente de asesinar a la esposa de un sheriff de Arizona.

programme.title: La Estafa
programme.desc: Clifford Irving vende la biografía falsa de Howard Hughes a una editorial a principios de los años setenta, lo que provoca un frenesí fantástico en los medios.

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES
programme.desc: En 'The Expendables' el trío de héroes de acción compuesto por Stallone, Statham y Li formarán parte de un comando de mercenarios que se infiltrarán en un país de Sudamérica y lucharán contra un un cruel dictador para liberar a la población.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: El viaje de tres amigas da un giro cuando creen que una de ellas es una mujer de la alta sociedad.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Theresa lleva a casa a Simon para anunciar su boda en la fiesta de aniversario de su padre.

programme.title: El Pequeño Gangster
programme.desc: Rik Boskamp es hijo de un contable y no soporta el acoso escolar. Viendo una película sobre la Mafia, tiene una idea que le parece brillante.Rik convence a sus padres para que se trasladen a otra ciudad con su familia, para empezar de nuevo en lugar nuevo

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operación Stormbreaker
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su tío, el colegial de 14 años Alex Rider es obligado por la División de Operaciones Especiales del servicio secreto de inteligencia del Reino Unido, MI6, a una misión que salvará millones de vidas.

programme.title: Time Toys
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños descubren un cofre lleno de increíbles juguetes del futuro, que les servirán para salvar primero su barrio y después el planeta de un empresario loco.

programme.title: Una Navidad muy Britanica
programme.desc: El vuelo de la cantante de ópera Jessica a su concierto en Viena se retrasa y ella se queda varada en Yorkshire. El único lugar para quedarse es un bed and breakfast en un pueblo encantador dirigido por un apuesto viudo llamado Andrew.

programme.title: Christmas Break, A
programme.desc: Cuando la maestra Addison Tate se entera de que su escuela va a cerrar, decide hacer que esta Navidad sea especial para sus alumnos. Solicita la ayuda de Danny y la química entre ellos se reaviva cuando salvan la escuela justo antes de Nochebuena.

programme.title: Enchanted Christmas
programme.desc: Cuando se fue de Utah como una joven viuda, Laura Trudeau dejó atrás a su padre, su amor por la danza y una vieja angustia.

programme.title: Una cenicienta de moda
programme.desc: El sueño de Kate es diseñar para las casas de alta costura. A pesar de que es una joven con un brillante talento, Kate no puede conseguir un trabajo. Y es que nadie confía en lahijade Lee Kassell, un minorista que comercializa diseños de baja calidad.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: Travesuras de una Princesa
programme.desc: La «primera hija» busca una experiencia universitaria normal, pero los peligros inherentes a su título la persiguen. Por ello, el Servicio Secreto asigna a un joven agente encubierto para vigilarla.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Russell (Christian Bale), un trabajador del acero, toma un asunto familiar en sus propias manos cuando su hermano, Rodney (Casey Affleck) se involucra con uno de los sindicatos del crimen más rudos del noreste y luego desaparece.

programme.title: Regresión
programme.desc: Un detective y un psicoanalista descubren pruebas de un culto satánico mientras investigan el aterrador pasado de una joven.

programme.title: Extraño pero Cierto
programme.desc: Una mujer sorprende a la familia de su novio fallecido diciéndoles que está embarazada de él.

programme.title: La Historia de Pedro y Pablo
programme.desc: Al quedar huérfanos Pedro y Pablo tendrán que separarse para que uno estudie para así tener una mejor vida, pedro nunca imagino que en su sacrificio perdería también a la mujer de su vida.

programme.title: La Hummer y El Camaro Azul
programme.desc: El Canelo es un joven gatillero al servicio del cartel, su trabajo es muy sencillo, transportar grandes cantidades de dinero y cargas especiales del patrón y lo hace manejando un Camaro azul deportivo.

programme.title: La Muerte de un Federal
programme.desc: Una banda de narcos quiere sobornar a unos federales en especial a uno, Rodolfo Campos para así obtener camino libre para transportar sus drogas en diferentes territorios

programme.title: Ay Chabela
programme.desc: Jose Francisco, Luciano y Chabela desde la infancia fueron inseparables amigos. Pero el destino ha decidido separarlos ya que los padres de José han decido que su hijo estudie en un colegio en los estados unidos.

programme.title: Cacería Humana
programme.desc: Andres Montoya, un experto buceador de Santo Domingo, es asignado por el señor Jackson para recuperar un tesoro sumergido en las bermudas, un peligroso punto donde abundan agresivos tiburones por lo que la misión resulta seriamente complicada.

programme.title: Carrera Contra La Muerte
programme.desc: Daniel y Raúl son dos jóvenes hermanos con una relación estrecha, esto cambia cuando sufren la muerte de su padre, pues al dar con el asesino Daniel decide quedarse en durango para continuar con su vida de juego y competencias de velocidad.

programme.title: Cuatro A La Fuga
programme.desc: Tres policías retirados ayudan a la hija de un traficante a auto secuestrarse. Luego de pagar el secuestro el padre descubre el engaño y trata de matar a los cómplices de su hija y mata a uno de ellos.

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Joe Braven es un humilde leñador que vive en la frontera de los Estados Unidos. Cuando es asaltado por un grupo de traficantes de drogas en la recluida cabaña donde vive, hará todo lo que puede para proteger a su familia.

programme.title: El disparo
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo han eliminado los sistemas de apoyo del Fantasma y las maniobras de Kane para disparar al hombre responsable del ataque en su recinto, pero el FBI se ha dado cuenta de las actividades de Kane y quieren que se detenga.

programme.title: Guerra en las calles
programme.desc: La investigación "E" se lleva a cabo sin problemas hasta que el principal jefe de Seattle P.D. ordenó a Kane (Steven Seagal) que actuara como seguridad para un excéntrico documentalista.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Traumado por la pérdida de su pierna, Nog se refugia en el mundo holográfico de 1960 del cantante de salón Vic Fontaine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Cuando Ezri regresa a casa para investigar la desaparición de O'Brien, descubre secretos familiares inquietantes.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Quark y Rom arriesgan sus vidas al cruzar a un universo paralelo maligno para rescatar al líder del planeta natal de Quark.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Ezri convoca los recuerdos homicidas suprimidos de una encarnación de Dax anterior para resolver una serie de asesinatos.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Un cambiante nómade le pide a Odo que abandone la estación espacial y se una a la búsqueda de su hermano cambiaformas.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Bashir se convierte en un peón involuntario en un juego mortal entre las fuerzas de inteligencia romulanas y una organización encubierta de la Flota Estelar.

programme.title: Trol: Destrucción Total
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes investiga una serie de misteriosos asesinatos de osos, pero se entera de que están ocurriendo cosas mucho más peligrosas. Empiezan a seguir a un misterioso cazador, enterándose de que en realidad es un cazador de trolls.

programme.title: El cuento de los cuentos
programme.desc: Basada en la obra "El cuento de los cuentos" del escritor napolitano del siglo XVII, Giambatista Basile. Esta película es una adaptación mágica, trágica y sangrienta de unos cuentos que sirvieron de inspiración para los hermanos Grimm.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Viva Chihuahua
programme.desc: Miguel lopez, es un abogado cuya profesion le ha traido muy buenas referencias con su proxima familia politica y su futura esposa laura, pero con un lado obscuro, miguel tiene una doble personalidad con la que se hace llamar pancho lopez.

programme.title: Viva El Amor
programme.desc: Una joven bella y liberada francesa decide tener un amorio con un hombre casado e ir con el a la habana, pero le exige a su compañero que pida su divorcio. Su esposa le pide a su vez que, para aceptar, debe conocer a su amante; asi que la lleva ante ella.

programme.title: Vuelve El Texano
programme.desc: El texano, es un hombre muy famoso del pueblo de Santa Fe, el decide regresar a su pueblo natal, a su llegada se entera de que alguien ha estado matando a varias personas e incluso a extorsionarlas por lo que decide descubrir y eliminar al susodicho.

programme.title: La conquista de Siberia
programme.desc: Un joven oficial en Siberia enfrenta amor, ambición y una conspiración por el oro de Yarkand.

programme.title: Jóvenes y rebeldes
programme.desc: Cuatro adolescentes deben vivir en la naturaleza después de matar accidentalmente a un soldado.

programme.title: La última jornada
programme.desc: Intentando salvar el mundo, Sira se embarca en búsqueda de un lugar místico que concede deseos.

programme.title: Doble amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven con doble personalidad arrastra a un hombre a una fuga entre mafiosos.

programme.title: Mafia en la Sangre
programme.desc: Una fiscal lucha contra un poderoso sindicato mafioso ejerciendo presión sobre sus estrechas conexiones familiares.

programme.title: Pecados de la Mafia
programme.desc: En las calles plagadas de delincuencia de Nápoles, un sacerdote recién llegado se enfrenta a la mafia local y desafía su control sobre la comunidad.

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Después de que se rompe su camioneta, cuatro prostitutas se encuentran varadas en una gasolinera en medio de la nada. Pronto se dan cuenta de que han caído en una trampa mortal.

programme.title: El hechicero y la serpiente blanca
programme.desc: Un hechicero lucha contra una avalancha de demonios seductores para salvar el alma de un hombre de una serpiente antigua que cobró vida en el cuerpo de una mujer.

programme.title: The Reunion
programme.desc: Tres hermanos distanciados, trabajan como fiadores, y deben cruzar sus caminos con un narcotraficante y hombre de negocios asesino en México.

programme.title: La invasión
programme.desc: Una agradable y tranquila ciudad australiana comienza a recibir señales de extraña y desconocida procedencia. Bajo esta tensa situación, un exigente jugador de rugby se enfrentará a dicha amenaza junto a otros habitantes de la zona.

programme.title: 6 Balas
programme.desc: Un mercenario que se especializa en buscar niños desaparecidos es contratado para rescatar a la hija secuestrada de un campeón de artes marciales mixtas.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI corre contra el tiempo para localizar y desactivar una bomba radiactiva que estallará en medio del centro de Miami.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Horatio y el equipo de CSI se enfrentan a la infame y mortal pandilla Mala Noche de Miami después de que un funeral se convierte en el escenario de un asesinato.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Un accidente de navegación familiar revela un siniestro complot de estafadores para robar diez millones de dólares en lingotes de oro. Horatio y el equipo de CSI investigan.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: El equipo investiga el asesinato de una adolescente que estaba de fiesta en Miami de camino a las Bahamas con su clase de secundaria.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Un joven enfrenta cadena perpetua, y posiblemente algo peor, a menos que Horatio pueda probar su inocencia contra adversidades insuperables.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: El equipo del NCIS se sorprende cuando descubren la cabeza cortada de un marino en un taller de desguace automotriz ilegal dirigido por infantes de marina.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: El equipo investiga la misteriosa explosión de una ambulancia que supuestamente transportaba los restos de un marine muerto en un accidente de auto.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son convocados para investigar cuando un grupo de adolescentes descubre placas de identificación marinas en un bosque nacional durante una caminata.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son llamados cuando un estudiante adolescente en una preparatoria de la base de Quantico coloca una bomba en su cuerpo y toma como rehenes a sus compañeros.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son llamados cuando un par de niños se topan con el cadáver de un marine desaparecido en un lago congelado. Mientras el equipo busca pistas en el lecho del lago, se encuentran con otros tres cadáveres acribillados a balazos.

programme.title: NCIS LT
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son llamados cuando aparentemente se suicida un criptógrafo del Pentágono sospechado de espiar. Con su principal sospechoso muerto, el equipo del NCIS debe descubrir si ella era o no el topo del Pentágono.

programme.title: The Librarians
programme.desc: Flynn lidera una misión para rescatar a Charlene de su secuestro.

programme.title: Alarm for Cobra

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
